name: Entity Type Permissions
description: Generates per-entity-type / per-bundle access permissions for content entities and enforces them through hook_entity_access(), with an admin form to choose which entity types are governed.
project_description: Entity Type Permissions is a fork of Entity Bundle Permissions that lets a site set up access permissions for any content-based entity type. After installation you choose, on the module's settings form, which entity types should have permissions generated; for each selected entity type it creates one "Access" permission per bundle. The permissions page stays compact because unselected entity types generate nothing, and clearing an entity type's checkbox revokes and removes its permissions from all roles (no "reverse permissions" model required). Permissions are grouped by base entity type (Content, Comment, Media, etc.) and then by bundle. Access is enforced through hook_entity_access(), which grants access to holders of the matching per-bundle permission and stays neutral otherwise. Works on PHP 7.4 and PHP 8.
